next_research.unresolved_question: Whether the velocity-level change mismatch (7.27e-3 / 6.76e-3 m/s) and the ~2.7e-3 m projection offset persist on independent fresh tasks, or are artifacts of development data and retrospective setup — and whether anything at a candidate-specific level is distinguishable before weight-dependent updates.

arguments.reasoning:
Primary action: D — retain local diagnosis only and defer run-ahead screening. A is unsupported: refinement is not a material error term (refinement shifts are 1e-5 m / 2e-4 m/s against a 2.6e-3 m endpoint offset). B has no identified specific defect to repair. C's preview is weight-independent and cannot license candidate-specific screening. D matches the evidence: the local one-step model is directionally adequate, coarse reproduction is exact, and residual deficit is projection-level, not integration-level.

Coarse production reproduction (checkpoint 0.3 s): batch-387f92fd17f0639f-0 reproduces its saved trajectory to 2.62e-11 m position and 2.62e-9 m/s velocity; batch-387f92fd17f0639f-1 to 9.19e-10 m and 9.20e-8 m/s. Replay is therefore faithful at the checkpoint.

Initial/vector/change errors, 0.3→0.31 s (candidate 0 / candidate 1): initial endpoint error 2.616e-3 / 2.620e-3 m; initial projection error [6.54e-4, -1.686e-3, -1.990e-3] m, norm 2.689e-3 m, so the projection offset alone is ~2.7 mm. Endpoint position-error norm 2.632e-3 / 2.680e-3 m ≈ initial projection error — the interval adds almost nothing. Position change-error norm 9.07e-5 / 5.71e-5 m. Velocity change-error norm 7.27e-3 / 6.76e-3 m/s; speed change-error -6.35e-3 / -5.13e-3 m/s (predicted 4.82e-3 vs observed 1.117e-2 m/s). Dominant deficit is thus velocity-level change, an order above the 1e-4 m/s reporting tolerance, while position change is far smaller.

Refinement contributions / fine-step differences: candidate 0 fine-vs-coarse 1.207e-5 m position, 2.07e-4 m/s speed, 2.47e-4 m/s velocity (candidate 1: 6.94e-6 m, 1.29e-4 m/s, 1.73e-4 m/s). Step-10 endpoints differ ~1e-4 m from step-1 (2.632e-3 vs 2.719e-3 m). One-to-two orders below the endpoint offset; a single smaller finer value is not convergence, and matching speed norm is not a vector match. All three integrations report root_residual_verified (max_scaled_residual ≤2.4e-14), so solver residuals are not the cause.

Unresolved causes: projection, omitted modes, transcription and integration are blended; the velocity change mismatch is not explained by refinement — no broad causal claim is made.

Weight behavior: at 0.30 s all three holding weights (0.05/0.075/0.15) yield identical first_command and identical position/speed checks — checks_depend_on_weights=false — with seed_settled=true, selected_iteration=0, selected_plan_is_seed=true, optimized_before_acceptance=false, stop_reason=verified_settled_seed, scaled_violation 5.28e-12. Thresholds are 0.005 m position / 0.02 m/s speed; max selected plan error 1.360e-3 m, max plan speed 1.9916e-2 m/s. Because the callback stops at iteration zero, the settled seed is weight-independent and does not discriminate the weights; cold equality does not imply full-task equivalence. At 0.2 s objectives differ mildly with weight (0.017375/0.017399/0.017470) at iteration 5.

Provenance: predecessor results (0/4 resolved, 0 local numerical passes, ordering abstained) and the one-step prediction summary (35 aligned, mean 2.641e-3 m, max 4.298e-3 m tip difference, world frame, no future-plan replay) are sealed prior prospective results now serving as development; interval records are current retrospective calculations; .075/.15 are development data. Incumbent batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0 / execution 91c3ba1b01d6499fb26df8f95409401b is retained; real_time_demonstrated=false with 35/35 deadline misses at 0.01 s (mean update 8.518 s), so real-time acceptance remains unmet; the 1e-4 m/s tolerance is preserved. M4 closed, M5 open. Production states, previous inputs and optimizer paths also differ, and historical warm plans are absent, so no warm-start-only attribution is possible.

Unexecuted future falsification protocol (prose only, independent of the zero operational budget below): on a fresh independent validation set of whole free-reach tasks (not .075/.15) executed with the same backend, compare each accepted first-step prediction against the independently observed next 0.01 s step over a full 0.35 s rollout, reporting signed position and velocity change errors with their order/refinement scaling, per-axis direction-correct counts, and an explicit abstention rule when saved scaled residual exceeds its seal; flag any threshold crossing of 0.005 m / 0.02 m/s / 1e-4 m/s and any real-time miss. Cost estimate ~6 local solves + 8 prediction evaluations, no backend stepping; cease on one crossing or after the budget.
